title: AutomaticSummaryToSlackWebhook
description: An Events API event_callback body carrying a file_shared event, as summary-posted reads it from an application/json request after the signature check over the raw body. Only a file shared by Slackbot (user_id USLACKBOT) starts a job; process-summary then checks with files.info that it is a huddle summary. A body of another type, or with another event, is answered with an empty 200 and ignored, and is not described here. Only the fields read are described; every other field is allowed and ignored.

channel_id.description: The channel the file was shared in.

file_id.description: The shared file; also the huddle job ID.

event_ts.description: When the event happened, as a Slack timestamp.
